messages:
maria: Heads-up — kickoff thread for the NimbusRetail POC. Need alignment on delta-sync semantics + SSE backfill + structured toolcall schema. Can presales + eng weigh in?

jordan: TL;DR: customer needs near-realtime sync of catalog updates, can tolerate ~5s tail. main asks: 1) backfill historic changes over SSE when they reconnect 2) toolcall for enriching items 3) deterministic structured output for downstream ingest.

deepak: Re: backfill — recommend streaming deltas with a resume token (cursor) + server-side TTL. on reconnect, client sends last_cursor to resume. simple pattern avoids full replays.

lee: SDK note: Python/JS clients already expose resumeToken in StreamingClient.start(). we can add example for presales. also mention our rate-limit headers (x-rw-rl-remaining / x-rw-rl-reset).

maria: @deepak @lee can you draft the minimal handshake snippet we can share with the customer? they asked for a runnable example in the POC repo.

deepak: here — minimal server handshake (pseudo):
```
Client: GET /v1/stream?model=redwood-delta&resume_token=abc123
Server: 200 OK
{ "type": "delta", "cursor": "abc456", "events": [...] }
```
On reconnect: Client sends last seen cursor, server returns events after that cursor or 410 if cursor expired.

jordan: perfect. what about toolcalls? customer wants to call an internal enrichment service for SKU normalization during the stream. can we do sync toolcalls without blocking main stream?

lee: yes — recommend async toolcall pattern: stream emits a 'tool_request' event with request_id, toolhook client consumes and posts result to /v1/toolcallbacks with request_id. server then emits 'tool_response' referenced to original event. keeps main stream moving.

maria: include security Q: they demand ephemeral creds + least-priv for toolhook. can we do short-lived tokens and IP allowlist? also SOC2 section in questionnaire — they asked about retention for SSE logs.

deepak: ephemeral creds: yes, short-lived JWTs via STS. IP allowlist via Dedicated/VPC config for Private. retention: default 30 days for streaming logs, can be extended with enterprise add-on. add to SSO/KMS answers.

jordan: pricing ask: CSM asked if backfill will massively increase token costs. need a short expl for them: backfill is charged per token like normal but we can suggest batch compaction for large historic loads and a one-time ingestion plan (flat fee) if >X GB.

maria: Good. Could we provide suggested retry/backoff code for clients hitting rate limits? customers often ask.

lee: example exponential backoff header-aware snippet:
```js
const max = 5
for (let i=0;i<max;i++) {
  const res = await fetch(url, { headers })
  if (res.status===429) {
    const wait = Math.min(1000*(2**i), 10000) + (res.headers.get('x-rw-retry-after')||0)
    await sleep(wait)
    continue
  }
  return res
}
```

jordan: structured output sample they asked for (very small):
```json
{"sku":"ABC-123","normalized_price_cents":1599,"tags":["holiday","fragile"],"source_cursor":"curs-789"}
```
Make sure schema versioning included.

maria: security team want a line for the security questionnaire about PII in deltas — they want proof we can redact PII at generation time.

deepak: we support redact hooks in the pipeline. we can add a note: "PII fields can be redacted/hashed at proxy layer before events emitted; retention policy obscures raw payloads" — add a short sample config.

maria: next steps: @lee assemble three snippets (handshake, retry, toolcall) into a tiny README in presales repo; @deepak draft answers for SOC2/PII/retention and ephemeral creds; @jordan will prepare pricing note and ingestion option. aim to ship to customer by EOD Friday.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered for presales/poc-examples repo branch presales/nimbus-sync — CI queued :rocket:

jordan: thanks — once README is up I'll loop in Nimbus procurement and attach the snippet to the POC runbook. :thumbsup:

maria: Awesome. tagging this thread for the POC tracker. if blockers appear (auth handshake or schema sign-off) call me.
